title: Enhance Multimodal Transformer With External Label And In-Domain Pretrain: Hateful Meme Challenge Winning Solution
reasoning: The paper describes a technical solution for the Hateful Memes Challenge, focusing on improving hate speech detection using multimodal transformers and additional demographic labels like race and gender. While the task (detecting hateful content) touches on social harms, the paper itself does not evaluate or benchmark religion, religious beliefs, or formal systems of ethics and moral reasoning.
